snippet.title: Author Sim | Game Announcement Trailer | 1
snippet.description:
*Game Description*
Have you ever dreamed of becoming a world-renowned author? Now's your chance! Study masterpieces from other authors, craft breathtaking stories, and maintain a public profile in pursuit of your dream.

*Wishlist on Steam*
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4168210/Author_Sim

Music Credits: Gentle Lullaby Loop by Frances Calceta | https://opengameart.org/content/gentle-lullaby-loop (CC BY 3.0 | https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)
